name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a pure restriction, and Absence(key_lost) hard captures it exactly. key_lost is defined as the event of the matching key being acquired and then lost before the door was opened, i.e. a drop while the door is still closed, so the ban is a plain Absence of that event with no Precedence needed. There is no unconditional command in the task, so the rule-only warning (empty FINAL_STATES) is valid, and key_lost can both occur and be avoided in this environment.

texts: Never lose the matching door key while the door is still closed.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost, u1) -> -10
